note: Golden set for MovieMotions retrieval. The ANSWERS are human ground truth and are model-independent — they do not change when the model or the pipeline changes. Only the SCORE against them changes. 'expect' lists every film that genuinely satisfies the query within this 20-film corpus. An empty 'expect' is a deliberate no-answer case: it measures whether the system can be wrong quietly, since semantic search always returns something. NOTE ON SCORING: recall@3 cannot reach 100% on a case with more than 3 expected answers, because only 3 films fit in the top 3. Case 21 has 4, so its ceiling is 75%. achievable@3 divides by sum(min(len(expect), 3)) to remove a penalty the system cannot avoid. PARKED: five hand-written mood cases (26-30) were moved to data/golden_set_mood.json on 25 Aug 2026. Removing them CHANGES THE DENOMINATOR, so the 81.0% (34/42) baseline measured with them is not comparable and must be re-measured before any Pass 3 change is judged.
